Rockstar hid a tribute to the green 1995 Mitsubishi Eclipse from the first movie in GTA 6.

In-game name: Maibatsu 97 Penumbra FF, painted bright green with blue graphics.

It sits inside a villa garage on Vespucci Island, among the Rialto Islands west of Vice Beach.

Drive west from Vice Beach to Vespucci Island.

Open the garage from the main garage door, not the side door.
